scenarios.title: Transfigure sacrifices the permanent and fetches a creature of the same mana value
decisions: A activates transfigure of Fleshwrither, tapping three Swamps for {1}{B}{B} and sacrificing Fleshwrither as part of the cost.
Both players pass; the ability resolves. A searches the library for a creature card with mana value 4 and puts it onto the battlefield, then shuffles.

variants.label: matching_value
variants.expected: Fleshwrither is in A's graveyard. Hill Giant (mana value 4) enters the battlefield under A's control. A's library is shuffled and holds only Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: no_matching_value
variants.delta: The library holds Craw Wurm (mana value 6) instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Fleshwrither is in A's graveyard but no creature card has mana value 4, so nothing enters the battlefield. A's library is shuffled and still holds Craw Wurm and Grizzly Bears.

scenarios.title: Transfigure may be activated only as a sorcery
decisions: Evaluate whether A may activate transfigure of Fleshwrither with the stack empty and three untapped Swamps.

variants.label: during_combat
variants.delta: The step is declare_attackers instead of main1.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal (can_play false), because transfigure may be activated only as a sorcery.
